shape.situation_pattern: Cheap tokens look cheap but the pipe has 1-concurrency and the operator is hitting walls/429s.
shape.decision: Launch as many concurrent streams as are doors that are OPEN; on a locked lane, don't fan out.
shape.reasoning_physics: Congestion costs time and calm more than money; a high-fan-out on one doorway is fifty people in a single door. Calm-to-completion is the real metric.
